message.content:
In a standard Texas Hold’em game the “hand” that a player can actually use is made up of their two private (hole) cards plus the five community cards.  
So the **maximum number of hearts a single player can have in a hand is seven** (all two hole cards and all five community cards are hearts).  

If you’re only looking at the private cards that each player receives, the maximum is **two hearts** (since each player gets exactly two hole cards).
